title: Crunchyroll’s Acclaimed Fantasy Creator Confirms New Release Ahead of Season 2
content: Kusanagi Mizuho’s beloved Yona of the Dawn manga returns with new side stories in the latest issue of Hakusensha’s Hana to Yume magazine. 16 years after the manga’s debut, the epic journey of Yona and her friends reached its bittersweet conclusion in December 2025.
author: ComicBook

title: New Fairy Tail Manga Miniseries Is Titled Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for manga creator Hiro Mashima reported on Sunday that his new Fairy Tail manga miniseries is titled Fairy Tail Re:Fantasia . The miniseries will launch in this year's 35th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine , which will ship on July 29.
author: ANN

title: 5 Best Anime You Probably First Watched on Fox Kids
content: There’s no shortage of places to discover anime in the 2020s, and viewers of all ages can find something to watch on platforms like Crunchyroll and Netflix. In the late ’90s and early 2000s, however, many kids relied on programming blocks like Fox Kids, Toonami, and Kids’ WB to discover new series within the medium.
author: ComicBook

title: Attack on Titan Confirms an Exciting Project With a New Trailer
content: Attack on Titan is an acclaimed series written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama. Produced by WIT Studio, the anime reached new heights of popularity in 2013. The animation studio released the first three seasons before giving up on the series since it couldn’t meet the tight deadline after the manga’s finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Game Announced
content: Koei Tecmo revealed during the "Xbox Games Showcase 2026" livestream on Sunday Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember , the sequel to Team Ninja's 2023 game Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty . The game will debut for Xbox series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox PC (and Xbox Cloud), and PC via Steam in early 2027.
author: ANN

title: Sega Announces Crazy Taxi: World Tour Game for 2027
content: Sega announced Crazy Taxi: World Tour , a new entry in its racing game series, during the "XBOX Games Showcase 2026" livestream on Sunday. The game will launch for Xbox series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store in 2027.
author: ANN

title: MAPPA Confirms Major Update on Shonen Jump Series Ahead of Season 2
content: Based on Eco Mikawa’s acclaimed sports manga, which began serialization in Shonen Jump + in 2018, the anime adaptation of Oblivion Battery was released in April 2024. Produced by MAPPA, the first season remained underrated but received high critical acclaim for its incredible story.
author: ComicBook

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Game Announces October 15 Release Date
content: Konami announced during the "XBOX Games Showcase 2026" livestream on Sunday that Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, a new game in its Castlevania series, will launch on October 15 for the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, Xbox PC, and PC via Steam . The game will launch in 2026 for the Nintendo Switch.
author: ANN

title: Among Us Showrunner Explains How Cartoon Network’s Infinity Train Influenced The Series
content: As a part of this year’s Summer Games Fest, Paramount had a big surprise that it dropped in fans’ laps. Not only did the studio show off new highlights from Among Us: The Animated Series , but it also dropped all ten episodes of the first season on Paramount+ immediately afterward.
author: ComicBook

title: Now’s the Time to Watch This 366-Episode Anime & Its Sequel Before It Ends This Summer
content: There are many great anime to binge on Crunchyroll in 2026 , but there’s one that’s especially worth digging into this summer — even with 366 episodes and a sequel series to get through.
author: ComicBook
